title: AI Ops Engineer (FBOS)
description: TL;DR — You'll make sure no one at Lovable spends time on anything AI can do. We're defining how AI-native companies operate internally, across Product, GTM, and G&A. You'll own the systems that let a 300-person team move like a 3,000-person company: workflow automations, internal AI tools, data enrichment pipelines. You'll use Lovable itself to build much of this. This role is part of Project Automate Lovable, working closely with our AI Operations & Automation function and FBOS team.Why Lovable?Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.What We’re Looking ForShipped production automations at a company: You've built workflow systems at scale that ran without you. Actual business-critical automations used by teams. Engineering brain, modern toolkit: You understand how systems actually work (APIs, databases, architecture) and can review code confidently. You move fast by choosing the right tool for the job: AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code etc) when they're faster, no-code (Lovable itself, n8n, Clay, etc.) when it fits, raw code when it's needed. Data is part of your building material: You can turn fragmented data across tools, databases, and external sources into reliable, usable systems. You’re comfortable designing data models, writing complex SQL, building enrichment and transformation pipelines, and creating the feedback loops that keep data trustworthy over time. AI tool obsessed: You're always testing the latest models, apps, and workflows before anyone else. You've deployed internal AI tools (Claude/ChatGPT with custom contexts, AI agents, MCPs, etc.) at a company and you're constantly experimenting with new ones. Can't unsee inefficiency: You see the whole company as one machine. Once you spot a broken process, you can't leave it alone. High agency: You don't wait for permission. You find the bottleneck, build the fix, and ship it. What You’ll DoOwn internal AI systems that make Lovable run faster than it should.Define how AI-native companies operate: Help build the playbook. What we learn here scales to every company using Lovable. Build internal tools and workflows: Using Lovable, AI agents, no-code, raw code—whatever gets the job done fastest. Lovable on Lovable first, always. Turn company data into operational leverage: Connect and enrich data across our stack, then put it directly to work, powering automations, internal tools, AI agents, decision-making, and proactive workflows across Finance, Business Operations, Legal, etc. Deploy AI agent armies: Claude/ChatGPT with MCPs configured so every teammate has AI working for them, not the other way around. Squeeze value from our stack: Make the AI features in Slack, Linear, Notion, Ashby, etc. actually deliver. Level up the team: Turn everyone at Lovable into AI power users. Document what works. Scale it. Own it end-to-end: You build it, you maintain it, you improve it. About Your ApplicationPlease submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal. Show more Show less

title: AI & Automation Platform Developer (Low-Code Solutions)
description: Job overview and responsibilityWe are looking for an AI & Automation Platform Developer (Low-Code Solutions) to design, develop, and implement intelligent automation solutions and business applications that improve Finance productivity and operational efficiency. The role will work closely with Finance and business users to understand process pain points, gather requirements, and translate them into practical automation solutions. The primary platform direction is SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP), and candidates with SAP BTP experience are highly desired. What you will doAutomation Solution Development- Design, configure, and deliver AI-enabled automation workflows and business solutions.- Develop scalable solutions to streamline Finance processes and improve user experience.- Configure business rules, approvals, notifications, and system integrations to support Finance operations.- Support testing, deployment, issue resolution, and continuous improvement activities.- Participate in proof-of-concept, pilot, and production implementation of AI-enabled automation solutions.- Identify opportunities to leverage AI capabilities to improve business processes and user productivity.Business Engagement - Work closely with Finance users to understand operational challenges and identify automation opportunities.- Translate business needs into solution designs and implementation approaches.- Facilitate user discussions, solution walkthroughs, testing activities, and user training.Integration & Technical Coordination- Work with Group IT and technical teams to support automation and AI solution implementation.- Coordinate system access, connectivity, security, and integration requirements for solution deployment.- Identify and escalate technical dependencies, risks, and implementation issues.What you need- From 4 years of experience developing and delivering workflow automation, low-code solutions, business applications, or digital transformation initiatives using enterprise platforms.- Experience working directly with business stakeholders and end users.- Experience delivering automation solutions, AI-enabled use cases, Generative AI applications, or AI agent solutions.- Hands-on experience with at least one of the following automation and AI platforms: Microsoft Copilot Studio, Dataiku, KNIME, Alteryx, Microsoft Power Platform, or UiPath.System Integration- Understanding of APIs and system integration concepts.- Understanding of application connectivity and integration methods through APIs, connectors, and enterprise systems.- Ability to troubleshoot and resolve integration-related issues.Communication- Good written and spoken English.- Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Education - Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Engineering, Finance, or related disciplines.Preferred skills and experiences- Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP) or related SAP ecosystem technologies.- Experience or familiarity with Finance business processes and systems.Why Candidate should apply this position• 14 Days Annual Leave + 3 Days Medical Leave• Private Health Insurance• Annual Salary Review & Performance Bonus• 100% Salary During Probation• Flexible Working Hours with overtime compensation during closing periods• LinkedIn Learning Premium Access• Microsoft Copilot Premium License (for eligible employees)• Global Exposure & Networking with colleagues across Singapore, the US, Europe, and Asia• Vibrant Culture & Festive Celebrations throughout the year• Modern Office in the City Center with gym, games area, conference hall, snack pantries, and collaborative workspaces• Regional Career Opportunities, including business travel and short-term assignments in Singapore(subject to eligibility)Report toTeam Lead Show more Show less
